eyebrow: A parameter is just a pre-filled variable
caption: Same procedure, different filter, each time you call it.

code:
CREATE PROCEDURE usp_GetProductsByColor
    @Color NVARCHAR(15) = 'Black'
AS ...

EXEC usp_GetProductsByColor;                 -- uses 'Black'
EXEC usp_GetProductsByColor @Color = 'Red';  -- overrides it
caption: No value supplied? The default kicks in automatically.
Unambiguous, order-independent — always name your parameters.
